tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Lina wants to talk about school art day. which picture to bring. what time to meet. who can help.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Lina.

promptBlocks.subject: Art day
paragraphs: I am writing about school art day. which picture to bring? what time to meet?
who can help? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Lina and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: school art day
ketImageBrief.panel1: Lina starts school art day with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Lina solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
